verdict_text: YES. The script loads all three checkpoints, verifies identical key sets and bit-exact equality of every non-MLP tensor against the base (which transitively covers ft1 vs ft2), then computes each of the 64 MLP tensors in float32 from the *unmodified* `base` dict — the merged results go into a separate `out` dict, so no ordering hazard — and casts back to the base's float16 dtype. It asserts `merged == 64` and `len(out) == 244`, keeps all other tensors and all names unchanged, and writes a single `out/T4/model.safetensors`. The duplicate `import json` and the unused optional `sys.argv[1]` override are cosmetic; the default output path is exactly the required one.
